law.text:
Each manufacturer shall publish a report on its publicly accessible website no later than January 31 of each year that includes:
The name and contact information of the representative responsible for the manufacturer's recovery plan;
The weight of computer equipment collected, recycled, and reused during the preceding calendar year; and
Documentation certifying that the collection, recycling, and reuse of computer equipment complies with § 10.1-1425.38 regarding sound environmental management.
